items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Charlie Gaines' and the interviewee (Benny Waters) does not respond with any personal anecdote, confirmation of a relationship, or correction, implying only a general awareness or no direct interaction shown in this snippet.

ctx.x: Ah, it was a trumpet player, but I can't forget his, I forget his name.
You called him Charles the other day, Charlie Gaines?
Oh no, not - more famous, no, I didn't say famous, I didn't say famous musically - no, we got it wrong there, Phil. I didn't say more famous musically, I said more known.
